summary: Runs one sha-pinned dispatch script as a lab job on the shared card.

request.name: kind
request.meaning: The job kind. Left out, the lab reads `hour`.

request.name: script
request.meaning: The script to run. Its file name must follow the kind's script name rule.

request.name: sha256
request.meaning: The sha256 of the script's bytes. The lab refuses a script whose bytes hash to anything else.

request.name: log
request.meaning: The log file. It must not exist: one start per log path.

request.name: cwd
request.meaning: The job's working directory; it must exist. Left out, the lab's own.

request.name: bash
request.meaning: The shell that runs the script. Left out, the lab uses its default (Git bash on Windows).

request.name: env
request.meaning: The job's exact environment. A variable whose name begins with EMBER_ (any capitalisation) is refused.

writes.meaning: The log; the lab creates it empty before the script starts.
The start receipt (ember-lab-hour-start-v1), written before the script starts and completed when it is running.
